Messages.Author: Aaron Hawes
Messages.Body:
What happens when bauble is burnt by some other means than by the
controlling Methuselah, e.g.. if the vampire with bauble on it is burnt
in combat. Is the associated equipment burnt as well. The card does not
explicitly state this but I believe that it implies that the equipment
is burnt if the bauble is burnt. This caused a rather major argument in
our last game so any clarification would be greatly appreciated.

Card Title: Bauble
Blood/Pool: 2 blood
Clan/Discip.: Vicissitude
Card Type: Action
Card Text: This is a +1 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting vampire. Search through
your library and put a non-unique, non-location
equipment card on another minion you control. Do
not pay the cost to equip. The vampire with this card
cannot attempt actions, block, or vote. You may burn
this card and the chosen equipment card when the
vampire with the chosen equipment leaves the active
region or during your untap phase.
(S) As above, but you may burn this card and the chose
equipment at any time.
Artist: Ron Spencer
Rarity: Rare

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Aaron Hawes wrote:
>
> What happens when bauble is burnt by some other means than by the
> controlling Methuselah, e.g.. if the vampire with bauble on it is burnt
> in combat. Is the associated equipment burnt as well. The card does not
> explicitly state this but I believe that it implies that the equipment
> is burnt if the bauble is burnt. This caused a rather major argument in
> our last game so any clarification would be greatly appreciated.

No implication is given that the fate of the equipment is tied to the
fate of the bauble card or the acting vampire. If the bauble-vampire
is burned in combat, the equipment remains, and is unaffected.

--

Bauble, 2 blood, Vicissitude, Action

This is a +1 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting vampire. Search through your library and
put a non-unique, non-location equipment card on another minion you
control. Do not pay the cost to equip. The vampire with this card
cannot attempt actions, block, or vote. You may burn this card and
the chosen equipment card when the vampire with the chosen equipment
leaves the active region or during your untap phase.

(S) As above, but you may burn this card and the chosen equipment at
any time.
